species.title: Blue sea star
species.appearance: Cobalt-blue skin, long rounded arms and a small red eyespot at each tip. The oral face has five grooves converging on the central mouth.
species.behavior: Any arm can lead. The player glides over sand, climbs all four glass walls and performs a two-second Reach. Idle and Dream driving share an autopilot route.

species.title: Chocolate-chip star
species.appearance: Broad tan disc, thick tapered arms and dark raised knobs. The knobs are part of the 3D mesh, giving the species a distinct profile.
species.behavior: Wanders between grazing spots on the open sand, with long rests between short journeys. Its heavier silhouette contrasts with the slender blue player.

species.title: Red Fromia
species.appearance: Small red star with tapered arms and fine dark pores. Three individuals punctuate the bare rock outcrops with warm colour.
species.behavior: Creeps along authored routes on the rock faces. These routes are prepared with the assets; the player’s free rock climbing remains outside the level’s scope.

species.title: Sand-sifting star
species.appearance: A flattened grey-tan body with slender arms and pale marginal plates. Its low profile lets the whole animal disappear beneath the sand.
species.behavior: Alternates between burial, emergence and short glides across the sand. Player contact is designed to trigger a quicker retreat beneath the surface.

species.title: Green brittle star
species.appearance: A 3.8 cm disc carries five tapering, segmented arms, each 15 cm long. The arms form different S bends and hooked curls, with small lateral spines and muted bands.
species.behavior: Rests with sinuous arms partly curled around its refuge. During escape, the middle arm segments row while the distal portions remain flexible and can lift from the substrate.

species.title: Cushion star
species.appearance: A thick, rounded pentagon with almost no projecting arms. Warm orange-brown skin carries an irregular darker net pattern.
species.behavior: Remains almost stationary. A gentle vertical puff provides a contrasting animation; the puff is approved stylization rather than a claim about the animal’s breathing.
